caption: The drawing features a single object resembling a stylized bird with mechanical or sculptural qualities, rendered in mainly muted, light colors such as pale cream, light grey, and brown. The bird has a smooth, elongated body with a rounded head and an additional smaller, round shape attached directly to its beak area, possibly representing another head or a mechanical component. Prominent circular markings are present on the body, neck, and head, giving the impression of rivets or joints. The bird stands upright on two thin legs which are connected to a flat, rectangular metal base featuring rounded corners and visible screws at each corner. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s signature “ALEX BUSH” appears in blue in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Cast Iron Pigeon
